# zoomToItemTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [zoomToItemTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/zoomToItemTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  SC.renderer.ZoomToItem (#3027): a scene of a large ground plate and two small bodies; zoomed to the far
#           body, the view is centered on it and its zoom fits its size, and the size of the scene stays; zoomed to
#           a node, a marker and a load; an item that draws nothing returns False and leaves the view; a wrong index
#           is refused. CTRL+A does the same for the item selected in the render window.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-10-18
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import *
import exudyn.graphics as graphics
import numpy as np

SC = exu.SystemContainer()
mbs = SC.AddSystem()

testError = 0
def Check(condition, message):
    global testError
    if not condition:
        exu.Print('zoomToItemTest: ' + message)
        testError += 1

oGround = mbs.CreateGround(graphicsDataList=[graphics.Brick(centerPoint=[0, 0, -0.05], size=[10, 10, 0.1])])
oNear = mbs.CreateRigidBody(referencePosition=[0, 0, 0.5], inertia=InertiaCuboid(1000, [0.2, 0.2, 0.2]),
                            graphicsDataList=[graphics.Brick(size=[0.2, 0.2, 0.2], color=graphics.color.red)])
oFar = mbs.CreateRigidBody(referencePosition=[4, 3, 0.5], inertia=InertiaCuboid(1000, [0.4, 0.2, 0.2]),
                           graphicsDataList=[graphics.Brick(size=[0.4, 0.2, 0.2], color=graphics.color.blue)])
nFar = mbs.GetObject(oFar)['nodeNumber']
mFar = mbs.AddMarker(MarkerBodyPosition(bodyNumber=oFar))
lFar = mbs.AddLoad(LoadForceVector(markerNumber=mFar, loadVector=[0, 0, -10]))
nGround = mbs.AddNode(NodePointGround(referenceCoordinates=[0, 0, 0], visualization=VNodePointGround(show=False)))
mbs.Assemble()

v = SC.visualizationSettings
v.view0.window.renderWindowSize = [400, 300]
v.nodes.show = True
v.nodes.showBasis = True #rigid body nodes draw their basis
v.markers.show = True
v.loads.show = True

SC.renderer.ZoomAll()
stateAll = SC.renderer.GetState()

Check(SC.renderer.ZoomToItem(oFar), 'ZoomToItem(oFar) returned False')
stateFar = SC.renderer.GetState()
Check(np.allclose(stateFar['centerPoint'][0:2], [4, 3], atol=0.05), 'not centered on the far body: ' + str(stateFar['centerPoint']))
Check(stateFar['zoom'] < 0.2*stateAll['zoom'], 'the zoom does not fit the body: ' + str(stateFar['zoom']) + ' ' + str(stateAll['zoom']))
Check(abs(stateFar['maxSceneSize'] - stateAll['maxSceneSize']) < 1e-6*stateAll['maxSceneSize'], 'the size of the scene changed')

for item in [nFar, mFar, lFar]:
    Check(SC.renderer.ZoomToItem(item), 'ZoomToItem of ' + str(item) + ' returned False')
    Check(np.abs(np.array(SC.renderer.GetState()['centerPoint'][0:2]) - [4, 3]).max() < 1, str(item) + ' is not near the far body')

#an item that draws nothing: False, the view stays
before = SC.renderer.GetState()
Check(not SC.renderer.ZoomToItem(nGround), 'a hidden node does not return False')
Check(SC.renderer.GetState()['zoom'] == before['zoom'], 'the view changed for an item that draws nothing')

#refused
try:
    SC.renderer.ZoomToItem(3)
    Check(False, 'an int is not refused')
except TypeError:
    pass
try:
    SC.renderer.ZoomToItem(oFar, mbsNumber=5)
    Check(False, 'a wrong mbsNumber is not refused')
except IndexError:
    pass

SC.renderer.ZoomToItem(oNear)
u = round(SC.renderer.GetState()['zoom']/stateAll['zoom'], 4) + testError
exu.Print('solution of zoomToItemTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
